chunks: As for whatever was in it from Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad al-Hamadānī, I have narrated it from Aḥmad ibn Ziyād ibn Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad al-Hamadānī.

key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْه: An intermediary narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمَدَانِ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical hadith term indicating narration
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father; indicates familial transmission within the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad al-Hamadānī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Ibrāhīm ibn Muḥammad al-Hamadānī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for tracing and evaluating narrations.
